description: This file defines a Flutter widget named BottomNavScaffold that implements a bottom navigation layout with five tabs, each represented by a placeholder page. It manages the state of the current tab, and presents a consistent UI with a top bar and bottom navigation bar, using external constants for styling.

classes.name: BottomNavScaffold
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a scaffold with a bottom navigation bar to switch between different tab pages.

classes.name: _BottomNavScaffoldState
classes.description: State class for BottomNavScaffold managing the current selected tab and building the UI.

classes.name: _TabScaffold
classes.description: A StatelessWidget representing individual placeholder pages for each tab.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for BottomNavScaffold.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the current index based on provided initialIndex, clamped within valid range.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including Scaffold, top bar, IndexedStack of pages, and bottom NavigationBar.
